title: Weighting a Membership and Patronage Equity Capital Retain by the Member's Standing in the Cooperative
content:
A cooperative asks newer members for more capital and long-standing ones for less, so the retain is finally weighted by the member's standing.

**Where the membership votes and has a long record.** Where the membership carries voting rights and 12 or more allocation lines stand on the equity ledger, the retain is taken at 0.9, that is at nine tenths.

**Where the membership votes and has a short record.** Where the membership carries voting rights and fewer than 12 allocation lines stand on the equity ledger, it is taken at 1.1, that is at eleven tenths.

**Where the membership does not vote.** It is taken as worked out.

## Points of judgement on hypothetical records

| Voting rights on the membership | Allocation lines standing on the equity ledger | The retain is taken at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 18 | 0.9 |
| yes | 12 | 0.9 |
| yes | 11 | 1.1 |
| no | 18 | as worked out |
| no | 4 | as worked out |

The boundary is at 12 allocation lines: at 12 the longer standing is reached, at 11 it is not. Whether the class carries voting rights at all is what the class schedule of Membership and Patronage Equity records against it.

**Worked.** A retain worked out at 93.00 is taken at 83.70 where the first line holds and at 102.30 where the second holds. Where the membership carries no voting rights the figure stands at 93.00. The weighting acts on the rounded product and the figure it gives is rounded to two decimal places.
